items.difficulty_reason: The proof of (2) implies (1) is a genuine descent argument for a graded algebra: after reducing to schemes via the \'etale-locality of relative ampleness and a refinement of the fpqc covering, it descends quasi-compactness and separatedness, forms $\mathcal{A} = \bigoplus_{d \geq 0} f_*\mathcal{L}^{\otimes d}$, transfers stalk-wise surjectivity of $\psi_d$ through the faithfully flat stalk maps $\mathcal{O}_{X, \overline{x}} \to \mathcal{O}_{X_i, \overline{x}_i}$, and concludes via the map-into-relative-Proj criterion plus descent of open immersions.
